About Synboli.

Accelerating polymer discovery for sustainable, high-performance materials.

Get in touch

Polymers in
everyday life.

From the clothes we wear to the electronics we use, polymers are part of everyday life. They also enable advances in construction, transport, aerospace and healthcare.

As those industries evolve, they need materials that improve performance, support human health and respond to environmental challenges. Synboli develops new polymers around these needs.

AI meets
experimental chemistry.

Specialised AI models explore structures and predict their properties. Patented synthesis turns promising candidates into physical samples for evaluation.

Combining computational and laboratory work makes discovery a connected process: design, produce, test and use the results to guide the next step.

See the technology

Faster discovery.
New possibilities.

The aim is faster development of high-performance polymers, including structures that have not previously been accessible. Synboli describes this combined approach as reducing development from years to months.

For industrial teams, that means a shorter path to market, access to materials with tailored properties and an opportunity to build a competitive advantage. These are the three benefits at the heart of Synboli’s platform.

Help shape the future of materials through chemistry and AI. Join our team in Bordeaux to work on polymer discovery alongside colleagues who share a drive for innovation.
